name: condition-tree-groups
note: all and any hold a list of conditions, which may be empty and may hold groups at any level (CUSC-072, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-group-shapes
note: A group has exactly one member, all or any, whose value is a list of conditions; any other object or element fails (CUSC-072, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-comparisons
note: A field comparison has field, op and value in any member order; every op of the list passes with a value of its kind (CUSC-073, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-comparison-shapes
note: A field comparison fails without one of its three members, with another member, with a field that is not a string or is empty after trimming, with an op outside the list, and with a value that is not of its kind (CUSC-073, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-judge-permitted
note: Under the parameter judge a judged text is a condition at any level; its text is a string that is not empty after trimming and its object has no other member (CUSC-074, CUVR-066, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-judge-refused
note: Under the parameter true a value that holds a judged text at any level fails, and the other conditions pass (CUSC-074, CUVR-066, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-values
note: A value that is not an object fails; an empty value passes as for every other rule, and required refuses it (CUVR-020, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-required
note: required refuses an empty object before conditionTree runs, and a condition tree passes both rules (CUVR-001, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-depth
note: A condition tree is at most 32 levels deep, the root being level 1: a leaf at level 32 passes and one at level 33 fails, whatever the leaf (CUSC-075, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-message
note: messages.conditionTree overrides the default message of the rule (CUSC-003, CUVR-067).

name: condition-tree-disabled
note: false and null disable conditionTree, so any value passes (CUVR-066).

name: condition-tree-repeated
note: A repeated field applies conditionTree to each row value, rows in sorted key order (CUVR-067).
